record.name: Costa Rica
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Costa Rica has a 2024-2027 AI strategy and pending AI bills, one of which (23.771) would make the science ministry the supervisory authority.

next_check.reason: Routine yearly re-check of a state where an institute is plausible (in Europe, the G20 or the OECD, or a signatory of the Bletchley Declaration).

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

News search from 17 October 2026 in English and Spanish, with the MICITT news listing (newest 21 October) and a separately found MICITT release of 28 October on cooperation with the Center for Public Intelligence. No qualifying item was found. The open-code, public-services agent and applied cooperation items name no frontier developer, evaluator or privileged access. The listing was out of date relative to the standalone release, and the status of bills was not fully reviewed. Partial check, not a full record re-check.

check.language_note: The recorded es query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: CR-search = searches 1, 2 (en, es). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: MICITT's launch account describes the National AI Strategy 2024-2027, responsible-use principles and implementation priorities.

related_bodies.name: MICITT
related_bodies.role: It leads the AI strategy and would be the supervisory authority in bill 23.771. It is the science and technology ministry. It is not an evaluation institute.

record.notes:
Neither the full strategy nor the bill text was read directly.

MICITT announced the National AI Strategy 2024-2027, covering responsible adoption, capacity and ethical governance. Searches covered indexed public English and Spanish sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
